title: OCA Watersports | Jet Ski & Pontoon Boat Rentals

services.name: Jet Skis
services.desc: Ocean City & Assateague's Most Legendary Ride - 6 miles south to Assateague Island National Seashore. While other Ocean City companies keep you circling the bay in a confined, buoyed-off zone - we take you on an adventure. From the inlet, you ride 6 miles down to the Verrazano Bridge along Assateague Island National Seashore - one of the longest open-water jet ski routes on the East Coast. Our signature 6 Mile Ride takes you straight past wild horses that have roamed since the 1600s, dolphins breaking the surface off the bow, and sandbars rising out of nowhere.
